lede: The biggest thing this week is Wednesday's slate of government meetings, anchored by the Ouray County Planning Commission's three public hearings — including a full repeal of Section 16 of the county's land use regulations, which is the kind of sweeping code change that reshapes how future projects get decided. Mountain Village Council is also voting Thursday on an affordability cap mechanism that determines whether deed-restricted units actually stay affordable long-term, and Telluride's P&Z takes a first formal look at the school district's employee housing proposal. Schools kick off Tuesday, so the valley's about to shift gears whether the meeting rooms are ready or not.

notable.stake: Repeal of entire land-use code section could reshape future county development rules.
